token.description: Short-lived access token. Use as Authorization: Bearer header on API calls. The TTL is deliberately NOT restated here — docs/system/administration/AUTHENTICATION.md holds the one table of token lifetimes, and a second copy is how this description came to claim an hour for a ten-minute token. A client must refresh from the refresh token rather than assume any particular window.

refreshToken.description: Long-lived refresh token (30 days). Exchange via POST /api/tokens/refresh for a fresh access token.
